name: PLATO Non-Commercial Convex QP Benchmark
description: Evaluates open-source and free quadratic programming (QP) solvers on 138 convex QP instances from the Maros-Meszaros collection, split across BRUNEL (46), CUTE (76), and MISC (16) subcollections. Problems have up to 93,263 variables. The benchmark focuses on non-commercial solvers, providing a fair comparison for researchers without access to commercial licences.
typical_sota_score: BPMPD solves all 138; IPOPT solves 135; OOQP solves 134. HiGHS solves fewest (110/138).
reputation: Standard reference for non-commercial QP solvers; Maros-Meszaros collection is widely used across the computational optimisation community.
notes: Not an LLM benchmark. Restricted to non-commercial solvers. Problems from Maros-Meszaros QP collection (1999). Variables: 1,500–93,263.
